concerns.text: The topological feature CSVs (`topological_features_{grid}.csv`) are described only as containing the persistence image vectors. The `feature_matrix.schema.yaml` contract additionally requires `target_property` (enum "logP") and `target_value` columns, which are not mentioned in the plan. Add explicit steps to include these required fields when writing the CSVs.

The `ModelPerformance` entity in `data-model.md` defines `r2_per_fold` and `rmse_per_fold` as arrays of length 5, implying one value per repeat. The plan states "5 repeats of 10‑fold scaffold‑based splits" (total 50 folds). This creates a mismatch between the schema (length 5) and the implementation (50 values). Either adjust the schema to allow 50 entries or modify the plan to aggregate per‑repeat statistics as the schema expects.

Principle I (Single Source of Truth) requires a clear designation of the SSoT artifact (e.g., a manifest or mapping file). The plan asserts compliance but does not specify which file serves as the SSoT. Add a reference to the concrete SSoT artifact (e.g., `state/projects/PROJ-444...yaml` or a `manifest.yaml`).
